Pyzed bundles the [Lucide](https://lucide.dev) font (ISC license) with about 2000 icons.
Search names with `pyzed icons <filter>` or on the Lucide website.

## pyzed.icons

### `icon`

```python
icon(name, *, size=16, color=None)
```

An icon widget. Also available as `pyzed.icon`.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `name` | Icon name. |
| `size` | Size. |
| `color` | Color (defaults to the text color). |

### `glyph`

```python
glyph(name)
```

Returns an icon's character, to use in any text with `font="icons"`. Raises `ValueError` if it doesn't exist.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `name` | Icon name. |

### `names`

```python
names()
```

Sorted list of all icon names.

### `for_file`

```python
for_file(name)
```

Returns `(icon, color_or_None)` for a file name, as in Zed's project panel.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `name` | File name. |

### `language_for`

```python
language_for(name)
```

Human-readable language name of a file (`"main.py"` → `"Python"`), handy for the status bar.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `name` | File name. |
